task.title: Clearing Machine Blockages & Jams
task.shortdesc: Safe procedure for isolating power, opening access hatches, and removing material blockages from the sieve boat or aspirator duct.

section.title: CRITICAL SAFETY WARNING
section.p: DANGER: NEVER insert hands or tools into the machine while power is connected. Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) is mandatory before opening access doors!

step.cmd: Press the red E-STOP button on the control panel or remote station.
Turn main isolator switch to OFF position and secure with personal padlock and lockout tag.
Wait minimum 3 minutes for sieve boat eccentric and blower fan to come to complete standstill.
Unclamp quick-release latches on side inspection doors.
Using wooden scraper or brass scraper (non-sparking), remove accumulated straw, foreign objects, or damp grain crust.
Inspect vertical aspiration channel and clean air distribution vanes.
Close all inspection doors, verify latches are locked, remove LOTO padlock, reset E-STOP, and initiate standard startup.
